name: fleetcore
description: API REST para gestionar los mantenimientos de la flota FleetCore

scripts.test: npm run test:compile && node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --config jest.config.cjs
scripts.test:watch: npm run test:compile && node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --config jest.config.cjs --watch
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:compile && node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --config test/jest-e2e.config.cjs --runInBand
scripts.migration:show: npm run build && typeorm migration:show -d dist/database/data-source.js
scripts.migration:run: npm run build && typeorm migration:run -d dist/database/data-source.js
scripts.migration:revert: npm run build && typeorm migration:revert -d dist/database/data-source.js
